\begin{document}
Let $\eta>0$. The external frequency is continued into the complex plane; the real part of $\omega$ is the
physical frequency. The retarded time integral is
\begin{equation}
\int_0^{\infty} dt\, e^{(i\omega-\eta)t}=\frac{1}{\eta-i\omega} .
\label{eq:ret}
\end{equation}
